messages: maria: FYI mkdocs linkcheck failed for /guides/sdk-usage after the nav/TOC migration. lots of 404s for snippet relative links :grimacing: maria: CI log excerpt: ``` Linkcheck: WARNING - document 'guides/sdk-usage.md' has broken reference 'examples/python/streaming.md#start-stream' Found 6 broken links ``` ben: ah — is this the TOC-compact plugin change that flattens headings? I ran into heading IDs being renamed earlier. sam: can you paste the markdown snippet that references examples? maria: here's the block. it's a fenced code snippet with a relative anchor we used for external linking: ```md See the example in ../examples/python/streaming.md#start_stream ``` maria: note the anchor in the target file is actually "start-stream" (dash vs underscore) — mismatch. ben: aha. mkdocs slugify changed from underscores to dashes in the new build. we need to normalize links or add explicit heading ids. sam: quick fixes: - update links to use dashes - add explicit HTML id: above the heading in examples (if we want backward compat) ben: prefer canonicalize to dashes and add redirect-list in mkdocs.yml for legacy underscores. maria: can someone open a tiny PR to mass-sed underscores -> dashes in docs path and add a linkcheck ignore for the examples dir while we roll it out? sam: i'll do the PR. will include: - changelog entry - mkdocs.yml redirect rules - CI tweak: temporarily skip linkcheck on /examples docs-bot: Deploy preview failed for branch fix/link-slugify — linkcheck errors remain: 6 failures. ben: ok let's land the PR in canary, monitor CI, and then bulk run a script to patch old links. Assigning to @sam :+1: maria: thanks! leaving a note in the migration checklist. i'll run a quick grep afterward to catch any remaining underscores. sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 maria: cheers :shipit:
